reason: Conversation 1 correctly identifies E:09 as a heating fault and, crucially, that this Bosch uses a flow-through heater integrated into the circulation pump assembly, which matches the hidden truth; it asks a sensible confirming question (hot vs eco programme) and lands on an engineer check of the pump/heater assembly. Conversation 2 gives a one-shot answer with no questions, implies the fix is a 'standard replacement' heating element (the unsupported cheap-separate-element framing) and speculatively floats a control-board relay fault without any supporting evidence. Neither offered the isolated resistance test or asked about age for repair-vs-replace, but 1 is more accurate, more engaged and less misleading on parts.
